testcases.name: minimax-music3-l0
testcases.prompt:
[verse]
Morning light filtering through the pine
Every quiet street is yours and mine
[chorus]
Softly the world begins to breathe
testcases.description: Genre: acoustic pop. BPM: 96. Key: C major. Warm and intimate, building gently into the chorus. Vocals: soft female lead, close and breathy, light stacked harmonies in the chorus. Arrangement: fingerpicked guitar and soft piano; brushed drums and upright bass enter in the chorus.
